name: TMF — Portal Auth (Register / Login / Orgs / Setup)

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { success: true, rawItems: $input.all().map(i => i.json) } }];
return [{ json: { success: true, rawItems: $input.all().map(i => i.json) } }];

const orgs = $input.all().map(i => i.json).filter(o => o.Slug).map(o => ({ slug: o.Slug, company: o.Company, country: o.Country }));
return [{ json: { success: true, orgs } }];

const r = $json;
return [{ json: {
  Email: r.Email,
  'Password Hash': r['Password Hash'],
  Company: r.Company,
  'Company Slug': r['Company Slug'],
  'Language Preference': r['Language Preference'],
  'First Name': r['First Name'],
  'Last Name': r['Last Name'],
  Active: r.Active,
  IsAdmin: r.IsAdmin,
  'Created At': r['Created At'],
  'Last Login': r['Last Login']
} }];
